edits.old: **Feature flag.** `rwb.litigation.record-judgment-v1`, read as a flag of the platform library; off means the step holds the judgment signal, writes no column and answers no move, and the sibling stories are unaffected.
edits.new:
**Feature flag.** `rwb.litigation.record-judgment-v1`, read as a flag of the platform library; off means the step holds the judgment signal, writes no column and answers no move, and the sibling stories are unaffected.

**Screen states.** SCR-19 and SCR-20 show four states: empty (no judgment is recorded on the action yet), loading (the read through the gateway-bff composite route is pending), error (the composite route answers 503 with the platform error envelope) and no access (the caller does not hold the Litigation right; MSG-P4-002 is shown and no judgment fields are read).

**Personal data.** The fields this story reads and writes are the action, the case state, the judgment date and amount, the rule ID with its version and the decision record. Their personal-data classification is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S4-E5016-APP-11).
